illustrations.art_direction: Use case: illustration-story. Asset type: editorial illustration for a minimal presentation about AEC project information. Style: sophisticated tactile paper-cut diorama, cut and folded heavyweight colored paper, subtle visible paper fibres, clean layered silhouettes, restrained architectural detail, soft studio daylight, realistic shallow shadows, slightly elevated three-quarter view. Palette strictly warm ivory #f5f2e9, deep forest teal #183e40, muted teal #24786e, sage #d8e9df, dusty terracotta #cf7258, occasional pale lime #d5f49e. Matte paper, no glossy plastic, no gradients masquerading as paper. Composition: landscape 3:2, isolated sculptural scene occupying the center 85 percent with generous uncluttered margins, solid warm ivory background #f5f2e9. No text, no lettering, no numbers, no symbols resembling code, no brand logos, no watermarks, no screens with legible UI. This is a concept illustration, not a product screenshot. Primary request: Show the enduring life of project information. A calm architectural archive of layered paper plans and model pieces forms a broad stable ground platform. Across the platform stand three small elegant buildings at different life stages: a concept mass, a building being assembled with a small simple crane, and a finished occupied building with a tree. A single continuous teal paper ribbon threads through the three stages and into the archive. Tiny human paper silhouettes indicate collaborators. Focus on continuity, accumulated knowledge and the long life of buildings; avoid a busy city or generic sci-fi technology.

Primary request: An architect's small inventive workshop where a designer creates purpose-built tools. An elegant paper workbench holds three different miniature tool panels: a building-view panel with a simple geometric building, a measurement panel with bars, and a checker panel with aligned geometric tiles. A pair of paper human hands assembles one small panel from cut paper components; finished panels are ready to use beside a modest building model and a stack of project sheets. Convey human agency and accessible software creation, without robots, magic sparkles, code, screens of text, or branded technology.

Primary request: Three independent architectural workspaces sit on separate small platforms above a broad visible layered teal foundation. Each workspace has its own model and neat archive. The shared foundation is the visual hero. Calm, legible, constructive architectural diorama.

Primary request: An orderly archive of project knowledge that can be reused. Three small different building models sit on three neatly layered sets of paper drawings, with small folded report cards beside them. Thin teal paper ribbons connect the model and report within each set, preserving their relationship. In the foreground a designer selects one card from the archive and places it beside a new emerging model. A small sage tree grows next to the archive as a subtle metaphor for accumulated knowledge. Keep composition very simple and premium, few elements, no digits or labels.

Primary request: A precise visual metaphor for deliberate access to project information. A neat architectural archive of folded drawings and one small model sits within a low teal paper boundary. A human paper figure opens one small gate and hands a single ivory folded file packet through it to a small specialist app panel outside. Other archive packets remain inside. The gate is calm and welcoming, no padlock as central symbol, no shield, no hacker imagery, no surveillance, no fortress. Emphasize selected access and human control, not a promise of perfect security.
